text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E, B, and D at gains felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; past price changes do not predict future returns.","I should assess each holding as part of my whole portfolio, rather than letting its average cost or whether it is above or below that cost dictate my decision.","After several months of holding through both gains and declines, I should avoid reacting to small fluctuations and trade only when there is a sound reason."]}
